boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Southwestern University
boards.description: Current, under-21-safe food stops on campus and around Georgetown with published evening availability.

cards.title: The Cove
cards.subtitle: McCombs Campus Center, Southwestern University
cards.notes: Head to the campus-center counter for a sandwich, salad, fruit cup, parfait, or drink when you need a food option that stays open through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Southwestern states that The Cove serves ready-made salads, parfaits, fruit cups, sandwiches, soda, and tea, and is open until 12 a.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Monday–Friday 9 a.m.–12 a.m.; Saturday–Sunday 7 p.m.–12 a.m. Confirm holiday and break hours before going.

cards.title: Chick-fil-A Georgetown
cards.subtitle: 1031 W University Ave, Georgetown
cards.notes: Use the University Avenue location for a clearly posted 10 p.m. closing time; choose dine-in, carry-out, curbside, drive-thru, or delivery as available.
cards.short_summary: A University Avenue option with service through 10 p.m. Monday–Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Chick-fil-A lists its Georgetown location at 1031 W University Ave with dine-in, carry-out, curbside, and drive-thru service until 10 p.m. Monday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Monday–Saturday 6 a.m.–10 p.m.; closed Sunday. Delivery is listed until 9:45 p.m.; check the location page for changes.

cards.title: I-35 & Williams Whataburger
cards.subtitle: 202 S Interstate 35, Georgetown
cards.notes: Keep this 24-hour Georgetown location in mind when a late evening has run past other dining schedules; curbside, dine-in, drive-thru, and delivery are listed.
cards.short_summary: A Georgetown Whataburger with published 24-hour service.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger lists the I-35 & Williams location at 202 S Interstate 35 as having 24-hour drive-thru, dine-in, curbside, and delivery service every day.
cards.access_notes: Published as 24 hours daily for drive-thru, dine-in, curbside, and delivery; the location notes that holiday hours might differ.

cards.title: D B Wood & Williams Whataburger
cards.subtitle: 3706 D B Wood Rd, Georgetown
cards.notes: Use the D B Wood Road location when you need a late food stop with both dine-in and drive-thru shown as open around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger lists its D B Wood & Williams location at 3706 D B Wood Rd with 24-hour drive-thru and dine-in service every day.
cards.source_title: Whataburger at 3706 D B Wood Rd, Georgetown
cards.access_notes: Published as 24 hours daily for drive-thru and dine-in; curbside and delivery are shown closed. The page notes holiday hours might differ.

cards.title: Guapo's of Georgetown
cards.subtitle: Georgetown
cards.notes: Plan a Friday or Saturday dinner here if a 10 p.m. close is too early; the restaurant’s own schedule lists midnight on both of those nights.
cards.short_summary: A Georgetown restaurant with Friday and Saturday service until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Guapo's of Georgetown publishes Friday hours of 11 a.m.–12 a.m. and Saturday hours of 10 a.m.–12 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Friday 11 a.m.–12 a.m. and Saturday 10 a.m.–12 a.m.; Sunday–Thursday close at 10 p.m. Verify before travel.

cards.title: Thomathi Bros Latin Cafe
cards.subtitle: 3309 W State Hwy 29, Georgetown
cards.notes: Save this Highway 29 café for Friday or Saturday evenings, when its published schedule extends to 10 p.m.; it offers dine-in, takeout, and delivery.
cards.short_summary: A Georgetown Latin American café open until 10 p.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Thomathi Bros Latin Cafe lists Friday hours of 5–10 p.m. and Saturday hours of 11 a.m.–10 p.m., with dine-in, takeout, and delivery options.
cards.access_notes: Published late hours: Friday 5–10 p.m. and Saturday 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Check the restaurant’s site for special closures.

cards.entity_name: Mikey V's Tacos On The Square & Hot Sauce Shop
cards.title: Mikey V's Tacos On The Square
cards.subtitle: 112 W 8th St, Georgetown
cards.notes: Make this a Friday or Saturday Square stop for tacos and shop items; the business lists a 10 p.m. closing time on both nights.
cards.short_summary: A taco and hot-sauce stop on the Square with 10 p.m. weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Mikey V's lists its Tacos On The Square & Hot Sauce Shop at 112 W 8th Street and publishes Friday–Saturday hours of 9 a.m.–10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Friday–Saturday 9 a.m.–10 p.m.; Monday–Thursday close at 8 p.m. and Sunday at 6 p.m. Check for exceptions.

cards.title: Tony & Luigi's
cards.subtitle: 1201 S Church St, Georgetown
cards.notes: Use the Friday and Saturday 10 p.m. closing time for a late dinner option; review the restaurant’s current location page before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A Georgetown restaurant whose Friday and Saturday hours run to 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Tony & Luigi's publishes Friday and Saturday hours of 11 a.m.–10 p.m. at 1201 S Church St in Georgetown.
cards.access_notes: Published late hours: Friday and Saturday 11 a.m.–10 p.m.; Sunday–Thursday close at 9 p.m. Verify service availability before going.

cards.title: Blue Corn Harvest
cards.subtitle: 212 W 7th St, Georgetown
cards.notes: Schedule a Friday or Saturday meal at the Georgetown location when you need food after 9 p.m.; its site lists 10 p.m. closing on those nights.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Georgetown restaurant open until 10 p.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Blue Corn Harvest identifies its Georgetown location at 212 W 7th St and publishes Friday hours until 10 p.m. and Saturday hours until 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Blue Corn Harvest | Georgetown Location and Hours
cards.access_notes: Published late hours: Friday 11 a.m.–10 p.m. and Saturday 10 a.m.–10 p.m.; Monday–Thursday and Sunday close at 9 p.m.

cards.title: 600 Degrees Marketplace
cards.subtitle: 114 E 7th St, Suite 110, Georgetown
cards.notes: Use the takeout-focused Marketplace address for a Friday or Saturday 10 p.m. food run; the official ordering page lists its current weekly schedule.
cards.short_summary: A 600 Degrees takeout location with Friday and Saturday hours until 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: 600 Degrees Marketplace’s official ordering page lists Friday and Saturday hours of 11 a.m.–10 p.m. at 114 E 7th St, Suite 110, Georgetown.
cards.access_notes: Published late hours: Friday and Saturday 11 a.m.–10 p.m.; Sunday–Thursday close at 9 p.m. This location is labeled takeout-focused.
